meta.title: Acquired Brain Injury | Cambridge Hospital
meta.description: Rebuilding cognitive, physical and daily-living skills through coordinated care.

overview: Acquired brain injuries, resulting from infection, tumour, hypoxia or toxic exposure, produce complex, overlapping deficits in movement, cognition, communication and behaviour.
At Cambridge Hospital, our interdisciplinary team designs individualised rehabilitation and care plans to address each patient’s specific deficit profile.
Neurorehabilitation assessment guides therapy planning, and family coaching ensures that rehabilitation gains transfer into everyday life across our inpatient, outpatient and home care services.
